ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 65-70% of the fluke surface, contrasted with low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated at the perimeter and peduncle insertion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blobs occupy the central interior of both lobes. High-contrast dark-grey mottling is localized along the leading edges and central base. A series of dark vertical streaks are mapped to the 2D coordinates of the right mid-lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-20 pixels along the entire boundary; peaks are most pronounced on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary curve exhibits a concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch, with a sharp upward convexity at the outermost tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of circular, high-contrast dark pixel clusters (barnacle attachments) on the distal tip and trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct vertical dark-grey rake marks on the right lobe; several thin, unaligned linear scratches visible across the high-intensity white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible clusters of barnacle colonization on the right distal tip and distinct vertical rake marks on the right lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly irregular, deep indentation on the inner-left trailing edge, distinct from the surrounding serration pattern.
